1) the optimal representation for a covariate shift between training and test data is the one on which a risk minimizer is guaranteed to be robust, 2) this optimal representation can be found by solving a variational objective that consists of two components: discriminativeness and marginal support, and 3) we can make our objective practical for self-supervised representation learning by using augmentations to enforce the same marginal support on the training and test data.
